<RuleLanguageLinks current="graphql" languages={[{"id":"graphql","label":"GraphQL","href":"/linter/rules/no-root-type/graphql/"}]} />

## Summary
- Rule available since: `v2.3.12`
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/style/noRootType`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule isn't recommended, so you need to enable it.
- This rule doesn't have a fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**information**](/reference/diagnostics#information).
- Sources: 
  - Same as [`@graphql-eslint/no-root-type`](https://the-guild.dev/graphql/eslint/rules/no-root-type)

## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"style": {
				"noRootType": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Disallow the usage of specified root types

Prevent the usage of certain root types (e.g. `mutation` and/or `subscription`)

## Examples

### Invalid

```json title='biome.json'
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"style": {
				"noRootType": {
					"level": "on",
					"options": {
						"disallow": [
							"mutation"
						]
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

```

```graphql
type Mutation {
  createUser(input: CreateUserInput!): User!
}
```

### Valid

```graphql
type Query {
  users: [User!]!
}
```

## Options

### `disallow`

This required option lists all disallowed root types (e.g. `mutation` and/or `subscription`).
The values of the list are case-insensitive.

Default `[]`

```json title='biome.json'
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"style": {
				"noRootType": {
					"level": "on",
					"options": {
						"disallow": [
							"subscription"
						]
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

```

```graphql
type Subscription {
  user: User
}
```
